clue.text: Comedy hits the mark

parts.note: hits as a verb means slaps, strikes with the hand
a tick is a mark made to show something is correct

explanation.surface: A comedian's routine lands its jokes perfectly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hits the mark' reads as an idiom for success, but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Knockabout physical humour is a broad style of comedy.

clue.text: Shelter general and his team

parts.note: Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general in the US Civil War
a side is a team in sport

explanation.surface: A general takes cover with his troops.
explanation.definitionFit: The sheltered side, away from the wind, offers protection.

clue.text: Peg accepting a dashing fellow, a knightly figure

indicators.note: accepting means the peg takes in the other letters

parts.note: a peg is a pin
a lad is a young fellow, often a dashing one

explanation.surface: A dashing young man is welcomed as a heroic knight.
explanation.definitionFit: A champion of chivalry, one of Charlemagne's twelve knights.

clue.text: Cut short turn performed by spiteful woman and cardinal

indicators.note: performed suggests the letters of turn are worked into a new order

parts.note: a cat is a malicious, spiteful woman
E, east, is one of the cardinal points of the compass

explanation.surface: A stage act by a nasty woman and a churchman is curtailed.
explanation.definitionFit: To truncate is to shorten by cutting off part.

clue.text: Sleeping fish?

parts.note: a smoked herring, or jokingly one who takes a nap, since a nap is a kip

explanation.definitionFit: A smoked herring, punning on kip, a British word for sleep.

clue.text: Say nothing but rushed round and gave a special edge to things

definitions.text: gave a special edge to things

indicators.note: round means the word for rushed goes all around the other pieces

parts.note: sped means rushed
to call is to say or shout
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone hurried about silently while decorating.
explanation.definitionFit: Scalloped edges are cut in a series of curves, a decorative border.

clue.text: Frenchman trails badly in the strong wind

parts.note: M is the abbreviation of Monsieur, a Frenchman

indicators.note: badly suggests the letters of trails are jumbled

explanation.surface: A Frenchman struggles to keep up in a gale.
explanation.definitionFit: A cold, strong northerly wind of southern France.

clue.text: Wrongly portrayed as seeking prey

indicators.note: wrongly suggests the letters of portrayed are set out incorrectly

explanation.surface: Someone is misrepresented as a hunter.
explanation.definitionFit: A predatory animal hunts others for food.

clue.text: Feeling more restless?

parts.note: read literally as experiencing more of an urge to scratch, rather than more agitation or impatience

explanation.definitionFit: Being more fidgety or eager can be described, figuratively, as having a stronger urge to scratch.

clue.text: Has green eyes of the first person in France to have a new soul

definitions.note: the definition is a verb phrase standing for being envious; the answer is the adjective

parts.note: je is French for I, the first person singular

indicators.note: new signals that the letters of soul are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone envious is said to have a fresh soul in France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'green-eyed' is a stock phrase for envy, from Shakespeare's 'green-eyed monster'.
explanation.definitionFit: Envy is traditionally pictured as green-eyed, so one with green eyes is envious.

clue.text: Led to a large quantity coated in various colours

indicators.note: coated in means the large quantity sits wrapped inside the colours

parts.note: pied means patched with different colours, like a magpie
a lot is a large quantity

explanation.surface: Something was led to a great heap covered in multicoloured paint.
explanation.definitionFit: To steer or guide a vessel or plane is to lead it on its course.

clue.text: Justify show appearing after five

indicators.note: appearing after places the word for show behind the numeral for five

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
to indicate is to show or point out

explanation.surface: A performance is explained as coming on after five o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: To vindicate a claim is to prove it right, to defend it as justified.

clue.text: Knocks three times for the barman

parts.note: taps are light knocks
ter is Latin for three times, used in prescriptions

explanation.surface: A secret knock summons the bartender.
explanation.definitionFit: A tapster draws beer from the tap in a bar.

clue.text: Dancing a tango round the bishop is haughty

indicators.note: round says the shuffled dance letters go around the bishop's abbreviation
dancing suggests the letters of a tango moving about into a new order

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the style of a bishop

explanation.surface: Someone tangoing around a bishop strikes others as proud.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone proud and disdainful of others.

clue.text: Place each name inside the fruit

indicators.note: inside places the abbreviations for each and name within the word for place

parts.note: to place something is to put it

explanation.surface: Instructions to set a label within a piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A groundnut is the edible seed of a legume, loosely counted as a fruit or nut.

clue.text: Ban for ancient writer

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a scribe was a copyist in ancient times

explanation.surface: A prohibition on an ancient author.
explanation.definitionFit: To forbid or outlaw something is to ban it.

clue.text: Encouraging words during child-raising

parts.note: raising read literally as lifting a toddler up, not bringing up a child

explanation.definitionFit: A cheery exclamation said when lifting a small child or helping one up after a fall.

clue.text: VIP seen becoming thoughtful

indicators.note: becoming tells us the letters of VIP seen turn into something else

explanation.surface: A celebrity is spotted looking reflective.
explanation.definitionFit: A pensive person is lost in thought, reflective.

clue.text: Dangerously unstable-but not when chasing Sarah!

parts.note: Sal is a short form of Sarah; smelling salts, harmless

explanation.surface: Something is risky, except when it follows a woman named Sarah.
explanation.walkthrough: Sal volatile, ammonium carbonate smelling salts, makes the word follow SAL, a pet form of Sarah.
explanation.definitionFit: Volatile substances evaporate or explode readily, so are unstable.

clue.text: Topical variety of fuel

indicators.note: variety of signals a different arrangement of the letters of Topical

explanation.surface: A current affairs piece about types of fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: Mined coal, as opposed to charcoal, is burnt as fuel.

clue.text: Broken toy did have a strange quality

indicators.note: broken suggests the letters of toy did are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: A damaged plaything behaved oddly.
explanation.definitionFit: Oddness or peculiarity is a strange quality in something.

clue.text: Doctor I feel sleepy-but it was just a drop

annotationWithheld.why: Doctor I feel sleepy-but it was just a drop (7): DR + I gives DRI, but nothing in 'feel sleepy' gives BLET; likely OCR garble with no scan to check
annotationWithheld.clue: Doctor I feel sleepy-but it was just a drop

clue.text: Liken to remarkable British author

indicators.note: remarkable here suggests the letters of Liken to are remade in a new form

explanation.surface: A comparison is made to a noted British writer.
explanation.definitionFit: J.R.R. Tolkien was the English writer of The Lord of the Rings.

clue.text: Fitting clothes on the third man, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals the words are judged by how they are spoken

parts.note: a suit (clothes) on Abel, the third man in the Bible after Adam and Cain

explanation.surface: Appropriate attire is said to have been put on a third person.
explanation.walkthrough: Abel counts as the third man: Adam came first, then his sons Cain and Abel.
explanation.definitionFit: Something appropriate or apt is fitting for its purpose.

clue.text: Many a snake on board

parts.note: on the game board of snakes and ..., many a snake has its climbing counterpart

explanation.definitionFit: In the board game snakes and ladders, these climbing pieces pair with the snakes.

clue.text: Admiral turned to behold the armed creature

indicators.note: turned shows the letters of Admiral are turned into a different arrangement

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold

explanation.surface: A naval officer turns round to see a creature bearing arms.
explanation.definitionFit: This mammal is covered in bony plates, so it is armoured, or armed.

clue.text: Man to dispose of fish caught inside

indicators.note: caught inside says the fish is trapped within the word for dispose of

parts.note: to rid oneself of something is to get rid of it
char is a fish of the trout family

explanation.surface: A man is told to get rid of a fish that has been caught.
explanation.definitionFit: A given name for a male, so a man's name.

clue.text: Rogue in leading country house

indicators.note: leading means the country house goes in front of the word in

parts.note: a villa is a country house

explanation.surface: A rogue is lodged at a grand country house.
explanation.definitionFit: A scoundrel or criminal is a rogue.

clue.text: Money that is for the golf club

parts.note: brass is British slang for money
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Cash is needed to join a golf club.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned wooden golf club, the number two wood.

clue.text: About to shut up worker for feeling sorry

parts.note: re means about or concerning
pent means shut up or confined, as in pent-up
an ant is the classic worker insect

explanation.surface: An employee feels remorse about being locked away.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone contrite feels regret for what they have done.
